integrity: Exact analytic proof and standalone symbolic/high-precision reproduction are provided; independent scientific priority verification has not been performed. The mass-exact condition is an explicitly additional constraint.
scientific_limitations: Only real exact-arithmetic three-node closed diagonal-norm first-derivative FSBP for span{1,cos(kappa x),sin(kappa x)} on [-1,1], pi<kappa<2pi; no full PDE stability/convergence guarantee and no generalization to non-diagonal norms or additional nodes.
title: Reentrant high-frequency trigonometric SBP geometry and exactly three mass-calibrated grids
